<!--
Measured, not read: a figure's picture stands 20pt under its caption's
baseline in the .pdf and typst, whatever letters the caption's last line
has. The .pdf put a picture under a caption with a p or a g in its last
line 2pt lower, TeX spacing it from the depth of that line; .docx had 6pt
more after its caption, 26pt, and is checked by its style.

Titleone and Titletwo have no descenders, so the foot of their ink is the
caption's baseline; the second caption's line ends in some.
-->
